title: Dykema Launches Centennial Campaign to Support Legal Aid Organizations
description:
Dykema, a leading national law firm celebrating its 100th anniversary in 2026, is proud to announce that its Pro Bono Practice has launched a Centennial Campaign for Legal Aid, a firmwide initiative supporting legal aid organizations that have played a longstanding role in advancing access to justice and partnering with Dykema attorneys on pro bono matters. 
 The campaign, one of several initiatives marking Dykema’s centennial year, reflects the firm’s longstanding commitment to serving the communities in which its attorneys and professionals live and work. Pro bono service has been an important part of Dykema’s commitment to the legal profession and its communities for generations, and the Centennial Campaign provides an opportunity to recognize organizations that have been invaluable partners in that work.
